reviews.t: Sooooo comfortable! I'm a big grandma & find this generous ...
reviews.x: Sooooo comfortable! I'm a big grandma & find this generous padded leather seat to be just perfect for my lower back pain. I use it in the dining room & finally can linger with family or enjoy lengthy puzzle sessions. It's made a big difference in my quality of life.

reviews.t: Padding is key; Look elsewhere for best price
reviews.x: Found one on sale through JC Penny for $25; don't know why, and the next week it was back up to $99.  Glad I bought this one, as it seems to be the only one with thick padding in this price range.  Check JC Penny first. But don't buy a cheaper one unless you plan to pad it yourself.

reviews.t: Very comfortable and moves around very easily
reviews.x: I'm a RDH, wish I would have bought those stool a long time ago. Very comfortable and moves around very easily. Super easy to put together.

The stool is well made but I find uncomfortable for my quads. I am short. However I think I will get used to it. The weight capacity was different in the advertisement than in the actual specs. That should be looked into and corrected. I do recommend the stool.

reviews.t: Many other ladies in the office have tried this out and like it as well
reviews.x: I am a dental hygienist and use this stool 10 hours a day 4 days a week.  It has helped to alleviate my lower back pain and prevents my legs from falling asleep.  Many other ladies in the office have tried this out and like it as well.  It was worth the price!

Adjustment handle broken within the first 30 days.  Worked on it to get the seat raised to where I was not sitting almost on the floor, after a day it sunk to the lowest setting again.  Junk, Junk, Junk...

reviews.t: The saddle works fine on our carped and if there's a complaint it ...
reviews.x: I ordered this saddle for my wife who owns a long-arm quilting machine which requires long periods of time on her feet. The saddle works fine on our carped and if there's a complaint it is that the regulator is located in an awkward place (rear of the saddle). It would be nice to have it on the side but I imagine that it is rare that it goes into use as she doesn't need to change the height once she initially set it.

I do facials and lash extensions and this has helped my back pain soo much! recommend!!! The only thing is that my thighs can get sore if I'm sitting on it for long periods, but its not worse than the back pains I used to have.

GREAT stool to replace my regular rolling one!  Very cush (the padding is almost like a stiff memory foam).  I like that I can even turn it around when I've sat for a long time and the pommel actually supports my spine sitting on it backwards for a bit.  I still have to get up at least once per hour, it's just not healthy to sit too long!  But if you sit a lot this is a GREAT stool!

claims.text: Reviewers frequently describe the stool as very comfortable, especially for lower back pain and long workdays.
Several users report the seat/saddle is very wide or bulky, which can make it hard to get close to patients or get on and off.
Some reviewers report durability problems with the adjustment mechanism, hydraulics, wheels, or base.
Multiple dental hygienists and other seated workers say it helps maintain posture and alleviates back pain during long shifts.
Reviewers commonly praise the build quality and value, calling it well made and worth the price.
